title: Design Your Own Keyboard!
summary: Ben Vallack walks through designing a custom keyboard PCB from scratch using Ergogen and KiCad, ending with a gerber file ready to order from a PCB fabricator. The example is a split keyboard.
why: HN recommends it as a thorough, general walkthrough of the steps in designing your own keyboard.

quote.text: It's targeting a split keyboard, but I think it details the general steps involved pretty well.
